name: Azmaveth
overview: Azmaveth appears in Scripture both as a personal name and a place name, reflecting its significance in Israel's history. It is noted as the name of a descendant of Jonathan and son of Adiel, who was counted among the faithful during the return from exile, as seen in Ezra 2:24 and Nehemiah 7:28 where the people of Azmaveth, also called Bethazmaveth, are recorded. Additionally, Azmaveth is identified as a village associated with the tribe of Judah or Benjamin, mentioned in Nehemiah 12:29 as one of the locations where temple singers were settled around Jerusalem, highlighting its role in the restoration community.
